Construct an explicit exposure table

Source: R/ingest-population.R
sl_exposure.Rd

Population is an exposure. Unknown ethnicity has no Census population denominator and must have NA population. Additional age_band and sex columns identify disjoint strata. Counts may exceed exposure.

Usage

sl_exposure(
  data,
  geography,
  classification = c("5", "19"),
  source = "user_supplied"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with geography_code, ethnicity and population.

geography

Geography type and vintage, for example msoa21.

classification

Self-defined classification, 5 or 19.

source

Description of a user-supplied exposure.

Value

A tibble with class sl_exposure and an exposure contract.

See also

sl_population(), sl_population_crosstab()

Other ingest: sl_archive_download(), sl_archive_index(), sl_archive_snapshot(), sl_assign_geography(), sl_boundaries(), sl_cache_clear(), sl_cache_dir(), sl_contract(), sl_list_versions(), sl_population(), sl_population_crosstab(), sl_read_records(), sl_sample(), sl_select_version()

Examples

sl_exposure(data.frame(
  geography_code = "area1", ethnicity = "White",
  population = 1000
), geography = "example")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   geography_code ethnicity population
#>   <chr>          <chr>          <dbl>
#> 1 area1          White           1000
